what_works: Most of the viewport is empty. A single initial-set wordmark and one sentence carry the whole top fold — the confidence-through-restraint reads as 'we don't need to convince you.' Perfect anchor for a conservative high-trust contractor.
what_does_not_translate: True zero-noise minimalism only works if the prospect has a strong existing reputation; for a new business this will read 'unfinished'.
type_observations: One serif/grotesk hybrid family at hero scale, body in a quiet humanist sans — generous leading, no decorative weight contrast.
